SELECT t.* FROM sys_flow_task t WHERE t.task_id = #{taskId} FOR UPDATE

SELECT t.*, m.category AS category, c.category_name AS category_name, m.model_name AS process_name, COALESCE(NULLIF(m.model_name, ''), t.process_def_key) AS process_definition_name FROM sys_flow_task t LEFT JOIN sys_flow_model m ON t.process_def_key = m.model_key LEFT JOIN sys_flow_category c ON c.id = m.category WHERE t.task_id = #{taskId} OR t.id = #{taskId} ORDER BY CASE WHEN t.task_id = #{taskId} THEN 0 ELSE 1 END LIMIT 1

SELECT process_instance_id AS processInstanceId, task_id AS taskId, task_name AS taskName, assignee FROM sys_flow_task WHERE tenant_id = #{tenantId} AND status IN (0, 1)
AND process_instance_id IN
#{processInstanceId}
AND 1 = 0
ORDER BY process_instance_id, create_time ASC, id ASC
mapper.sql: t.id, t.tenant_id, t.task_id, t.task_name, t.task_def_key, t.task_def_id, t.process_instance_id, t.process_def_id, t.process_def_key, t.business_key, t.business_type, t.title, t.assignee, COALESCE( NULLIF(assignee_user.real_name, ''), NULLIF(assignee_user.username, ''), NULLIF(t.assignee_name, '') ) AS assignee_name, t.candidate_users, t.candidate_groups, t.owner, t.due_date, t.priority, t.status, t.comment, t.signature, t.attachment_urls, t.start_user_id, COALESCE( NULLIF(start_user.real_name, ''), NULLIF(start_user.username, ''), NULLIF(t.start_user_name, '') ) AS start_user_name, t.start_dept_id, t.start_dept_name, t.create_time, t.claim_time, t.complete_time, t.action_idempotency_key, t.action_request_digest, t.action_type, m.category AS category, c.category_name AS category_name, m.model_name AS process_name, COALESCE(NULLIF(m.model_name, ''), t.process_def_key) AS process_definition_name

LEFT JOIN sys_user assignee_user ON assignee_user.id = CAST(NULLIF(t.assignee, '') AS UNSIGNED) AND t.assignee REGEXP '^[0-9]+$' AND assignee_user.del_flag = 0 AND EXISTS ( SELECT 1 FROM sys_user_tenant assignee_membership WHERE assignee_membership.tenant_id = t.tenant_id AND assignee_membership.user_id = assignee_user.id AND assignee_membership.status = 1 ) LEFT JOIN sys_user start_user ON start_user.id = CAST(NULLIF(t.start_user_id, '') AS UNSIGNED) AND t.start_user_id REGEXP '^[0-9]+$' AND start_user.del_flag = 0 AND EXISTS ( SELECT 1 FROM sys_user_tenant start_membership WHERE start_membership.tenant_id = t.tenant_id AND start_membership.user_id = start_user.id AND start_membership.status = 1 ) LEFT JOIN sys_flow_model m ON t.process_def_key = m.model_key AND m.tenant_id = t.tenant_id LEFT JOIN sys_flow_category c ON c.id = m.category AND c.tenant_id = t.tenant_id

AND ( t.assignee = #{userId} OR ( EXISTS ( SELECT 1 FROM sys_flow_task_candidate tc WHERE tc.tenant_id = t.tenant_id AND tc.task_id = t.task_id AND tc.candidate_type = 'USER' AND tc.candidate_value = #{userId} AND tc.status = 1 ) OR ( t.candidate_users IS NOT NULL AND t.candidate_users != '' AND FIND_IN_SET( REPLACE(REPLACE(REPLACE(REPLACE(#{userId}, ';', ','), '；', ','), '，', ','), ' ', ''), REPLACE(REPLACE(REPLACE(REPLACE(REPLACE(t.candidate_users, ';', ','), '；', ','), '，', ','), '、', ','), ' ', '') ) > 0 ) ) OR ( t.candidate_groups IS NOT NULL AND t.candidate_groups != '' AND ( EXISTS ( SELECT 1 FROM sys_user_org_role current_user_role INNER JOIN sys_role candidate_role ON candidate_role.id = current_user_role.role_id AND candidate_role.tenant_id = current_user_role.tenant_id AND candidate_role.role_status = 1 AND candidate_role.del_flag = 0 LEFT JOIN sys_role_org candidate_role_org ON candidate_role_org.tenant_id = current_user_role.tenant_id AND candidate_role_org.role_id = current_user_role.role_id AND candidate_role_org.org_id = current_user_role.org_id WHERE current_user_role.tenant_id = t.tenant_id AND current_user_role.user_id = CAST(NULLIF(#{userId}, '') AS UNSIGNED)
AND current_user_role.org_id = #{activeOrgId}
AND 1 = 0
AND (candidate_role.org_scope_type = 1 OR candidate_role_org.id IS NOT NULL) AND ( FIND_IN_SET( CAST(current_user_role.role_id AS CHAR), REPLACE(REPLACE(REPLACE(REPLACE(REPLACE(t.candidate_groups, ';', ','), '；', ','), '，', ','), '、', ','), ' ', '') ) > 0 OR FIND_IN_SET( candidate_role.role_key, REPLACE(REPLACE(REPLACE(REPLACE(REPLACE(t.candidate_groups, ';', ','), '；', ','), '，', ','), '、', ','), ' ', '') ) > 0 ) ) OR EXISTS ( SELECT 1 FROM sys_user_org current_user_org WHERE current_user_org.tenant_id = t.tenant_id AND current_user_org.user_id = CAST(NULLIF(#{userId}, '') AS UNSIGNED)
AND 1 = 0
AND FIND_IN_SET( CAST(current_user_org.org_id AS CHAR), REPLACE(REPLACE(REPLACE(REPLACE(REPLACE(t.candidate_groups, ';', ','), '；', ','), '，', ','), '、', ','), ' ', '') ) > 0 ) ) ) )

SELECT FROM sys_flow_task t
AND t.tenant_id = #{tenantId} AND t.status = 0 AND (t.assignee IS NULL OR t.assignee = '') AND (
( EXISTS ( SELECT 1 FROM sys_flow_task_candidate tc WHERE tc.tenant_id = t.tenant_id AND tc.task_id = t.task_id AND tc.candidate_type = 'USER' AND tc.candidate_value = #{userId} AND tc.status = 1 ) OR ( t.candidate_users IS NOT NULL AND t.candidate_users != '' AND FIND_IN_SET( REPLACE(REPLACE(REPLACE(REPLACE(#{userId}, ';', ','), '；', ','), '，', ','), ' ', ''), REPLACE(REPLACE(REPLACE(REPLACE(REPLACE(t.candidate_users, ';', ','), '；', ','), '，', ','), '、', ','), ' ', '') ) > 0 ) )
OR
( EXISTS ( SELECT 1 FROM sys_flow_task_candidate tc WHERE tc.tenant_id = t.tenant_id AND tc.task_id = t.task_id AND tc.candidate_type = 'GROUP' AND tc.candidate_value = #{groupId} AND tc.status = 1 ) OR ( t.candidate_groups IS NOT NULL AND t.candidate_groups != '' AND FIND_IN_SET( REPLACE(REPLACE(REPLACE(REPLACE(#{groupId}, ';', ','), '；', ','), '，', ','), ' ', ''), REPLACE(REPLACE(REPLACE(REPLACE(REPLACE(t.candidate_groups, ';', ','), '；', ','), '，', ','), '、', ','), ' ', '') ) > 0 ) )
1 = 0
)
AND t.title LIKE CONCAT('%', #{title}, '%')
ORDER BY t.create_time DESC

SELECT t.*, m.category AS category, c.category_name AS category_name, m.model_name AS process_name, COALESCE(NULLIF(m.model_name, ''), t.process_def_key) AS process_definition_name FROM sys_flow_task t LEFT JOIN sys_flow_model m ON t.process_def_key = m.model_key LEFT JOIN sys_flow_category c ON c.id = m.category WHERE t.due_date IS NOT NULL AND t.due_date <= #{now} AND t.status IN (0, 1) ORDER BY t.due_date ASC, t.create_time ASC

SELECT COUNT(1) FROM sys_flow_task t WHERE t.tenant_id = #{tenantId}
AND (t.status = 0 OR (t.assignee = #{userId} AND t.status = 1))
